mainline.title: Tracing the Consequences of Quantization in Closed-Loop Agents
mainline.question: On identical interaction histories, which task consequences do quantization-induced local action changes cause, and do they come from the current action, the subsequent execution, or their interaction? Can local precision restoration guide precision allocation?
evidence_layers: same-state action x continuation-controller forks (G, A/C/I, rescue/damage)
local computation/precision restoration linked to closed-loop consequences, validated on independent tasks
not_claimed: real speed or memory savings (fake quantization)

experiments.title: Replay acceptance gate (q4, q8, telecom)
experiments.fit: Prerequisite for every causal fork result; q4 passed all checks (8 states), q8/telecom and per-role hook configs pending.

experiments.title: Development blocks: Q runs GPTQ/AWQ-W4 d1 + BF16 on 20 shared nonces (q4, q8)
experiments.fit: The Q histories the four-branch forks start from; also paired Q-B success. Blocks = complete shared-nonce sets, not queue jobs.
experiments.analysis: fork development analysis (coverage, rescue/damage, G, A/C/I)

experiments.title: Paired BF16 on W4 fresh nonces q1-q5 (q4, q8)
experiments.fit: Success non-inferiority at 3 pp (measurement section). Non-inferiority is not equivalence; development evidence only (W4 results were already seen).

experiments.title: KV8 Q blocks on development nonces (q4, q8)
experiments.fit: KV axis of the fork study (P2). Forks blocked until run_fork applies per-role hook configs (W34).

experiments.title: Telecom development blocks (80 dev tasks; holdout untouched)
experiments.fit: Cross-domain development and mapping the mechanism taxonomy onto telecom tools before the holdout is frozen.

experiments.title: Same-state four-branch forks
experiments.fit: Core evidence: G = rescue - damage, A/C/I, per-fork annotation (defect, correction, requirements).

experiments.title: Layer/module BF16 restoration (byte-matched random controls) and alpha residual dose
experiments.fit: Local computation intervention and the deployment (precision allocation) test; checkpoints being built (engineering line 3).
experiments.analysis: restoration effect on actions and task consequences

experiments.title: A8 -> SmoothQuant W8A8 -> QuaRot W4A4 (fake quant)
experiments.fit: Activation axis for the W x A x KV comparison; named methods only after fidelity checks; excluded from main text if not accepted by 10-02 evening.

experiments.title: BFCL multi-turn and ALFWorld
experiments.fit: External validity without an LLM user simulator; accepted by 10-02 evening or listed as a limitation.

experiments.title: Telecom holdout confirmation (34 tasks)
experiments.fit: Independent cross-domain confirmation under PREREG_FORK_CONFIRM.md (frozen 10-03 before any holdout outcome).

experiments.title: Open-loop probes (E3, top-20 E4-2; ~50 cells)
experiments.fit: Background measurement only: the act/talk shift conditional on BF16 is mostly a selection effect; not quantizer-specific evidence.
